comment: Prehistoric/archaeological story pins (era "prehistoric" or tag "archaeology") with more than 1 decimal (0.1°, about 10 km; was 2 until 2026-10-11) are rounded by apply-story-overrides.mjs. Slugs/History ids below are exempt (tier C public sites, or already county-level).
includeComment: includeSlugs: protected regardless of era/tag (Eskippakithiki, Oct 11 2026: conservative default while KY History's opinion is pending; the John Finley story shares its Eskippakithiki pin and History id). extraProtectedIds: non-story ids (territory dots) added to protected-pins.json.
